h:
从 Illustrious 迁移到 Anima 一直是令人畏惧的，因为它依赖于冗长的自然语言描述来获得高质量的结果，而使用 Illustrious 时，您依赖于具有高度定义概念的标签作为“构建块”。

我创建了这个工作流程来帮助我导航，通过使用提示类别方法来获得更好定义的结构。

采用这种方法的部分原因是我喜欢调整提示和使用通配符，但自然语言很容易陷入困境。因此，通过将其全部分段，它允许我自由地调整提示的各个部分，而不会出现问题。

工作流程中包含一些示例通配符文件，其中包含我使用 ChatGPT 生成的少量随机提示以帮助入门。

v1.1 添加了许多自动和手动提示切换以改善用户体验。最值得注意的是，除非实际使用该类别，否则类别标题不再出现，如果您想要更多的手动控制，您现在可以完全禁用它们。

o.en:
Moving to Anima from Illustrious has been daunting due to its reliance upon lengthy natural language descriptions to get quality results, whereas with Illustrious you relied upon tags with highly defined concepts as "building blocks".

I created this workflow to help me navigate this, by using a prompting category approach to get a better defined structure.

Part of the reason for this approach is that I enjoy tweaking prompts and using wildcards, but natural language is easy to entangle. So by keeping it all segmented, it allows me to adjust segments of the prompt freely and without issue.

Included with the workflow are some example wildcard files, which contain a small number of random prompts I generated with ChatGPT to help get started.

v1.1 adds a number of automated and manual prompting toggles to improve user experience. Most notably, category headers no longer appear unless that category is actually used, and you can now disable them entirely if you want more manual control.
